description: This file contains utility functions to build various Telegram UI components such as pagination keyboards, provider lists, model lists, and browsing options, intended for integration with a Telegram bot interface.

methods.name: export function buildCommandsPaginationKeyboard( buildCommandsPaginationKeyboard
methods.description: Constructs a keyboard with pagination buttons ('Prev', current page indicator, 'Next') for navigating command pages.

methods.name: export function buildTelegramCommandsListChannelData(params: { buildTelegramCommandsListChannelData
methods.description: Creates channel data for displaying a paginated list of commands, returning null if only one page.

methods.name: export function buildTelegramModelsProviderChannelData(params: { buildTelegramModelsProviderChannelData
methods.description: Generates channel data listing model providers, or null if no providers are available.

methods.name: export function buildTelegramModelsListChannelData(params: { buildTelegramModelsListChannelData
methods.description: Produces channel data for a list of models with associated pagination and selection details.

methods.name: export function buildTelegramModelBrowseChannelData(): ReplyPayload["channelData"] { buildTelegramModelBrowseChannelData
methods.description: Returns channel data to prompt browsing providers, with no additional parameters.
